schema.obs: float32 fixed 8x8 visible grid, flattened and scaled, from obs_t
schema.legal_mask: float32 legal action mask over the compact training action set
schema.action_features: float32 generic action family/target/hash features from action_t
schema.action_id: int compact action index used only for inverse-dynamics diagnostics
schema.family: int generic action family target for inverse dynamics
schema.next_obs: float32 fixed 8x8 visible grid, flattened and scaled, from obs_t+1
schema.reward: float32 public reward/score delta clipped during training

training_objectives: intrinsic value from controllability, prediction improvement, progress, and no-op avoidance

unsupported_reasons: null training control is not eligible for improvement claim

no_hack_proof.model_action_source: old ARCAGI3Adapter action_scores optionally rescored by frozen external base predictions
no_hack_proof.selection_protocol: primary arm selected from non-ARC dev before official sealed evaluation

limitations: No external-base arm passed the sealed official ARC score/useful/repeat gate.
Generated ARC-like traces are pretraining data only and are not terminal proof.
The first-pass dataset is dominated by generated pretraining transitions; sealed evaluation remains the proof source.
Official ARC runtime remains serialized and slow even when model inference is CUDA-backed.
